title: After the Debut: Bring the Brat

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Sweep Tosho successfully finishes her debut race, it's clear that her sense of frustration kept her from being able to concentrate on running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When a reporter asks her what her next goal race is, her answer is blunt: the Hanshin J.F. When the reporter chastises her attitude, her mood only sours further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, she shuts herself in the waiting room and falls asleep. For now, I decide to keep her next goal as the Hanshin J.F.
